meadow.prompt_ground: soft warm yellow-green meadow grass like sunny Mediterranean hillsides, clearly visible brushed grass strokes in several greens and golden-greens, tiny scattered painted wildflowers in white and yellow

forest.prompt_ground: darker green forest-floor grass with fallen pine needles and small leaf litter

prairie.prompt_ground: golden dry summer grass with soft ochre tones

highland.prompt_ground: pale cream limestone ground with tiny pebbles and thin sparse grass

wetland.prompt_ground: damp lush green grass with tiny reeds and small soft puddle glints

scrubland.prompt_ground: ochre dry soil with sparse small dry shrub tufts

heath.prompt_ground: olive-sage low heather with tiny purple heather specks

clayland.prompt_ground: smooth, even warm terracotta clay soil with soft faint dry cracks; only a few tiny pebbles scattered sparsely and evenly, no clusters, no rows

beach.prompt_ground: warm pale fine beach sand with very faint ripples and a few tiny shell specks

shallows.prompt_ground: clear turquoise shallow sea water over pale sand, soft light ripples, seen from directly above

burnt_forest.prompt_ground: the floor of a burnt pine forest: soft warm grey ash and dusky brown scorched earth, scattered rust-brown fallen pine needles, small blackened charcoal twigs and flakes, a few tiny tufts of fresh green regrowth; muted and painterly, never pure black
burnt_forest.note: Stronghold island only (TerrainBiome::BurntForest). Two images requested; image 2 kept, image 1 rejected for large, sparse twigs and needles with little ash, which would show the repeat. Same post-process as the other biomes, then darker-than-mean deviations halved so the charcoal flecks survive the shader's 1.8x contrast lift.
